name: Echo Isles
summary: The Darkspear seek to reclaim the Echo Isles, now held by Zalazane. They first made their home there after crossing the Great Sea with Thrall.

sections.title: A Fractured Sanctuary
sections.body:
The Darkspear made the Echo Isles their home after crossing the Great Sea with Thrall. Their peace ended when Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's naval forces invaded Durotar during Kul Tiras' attack. The trolls drove back Proudmoore's fleet, but danger rose within their own tribe.

Zalazane, one of their witch doctors, took up dark arts and enslaved the minds of his kin. Chieftain Vol'jin and the free Darkspears fled again. Across the narrow strait, they found temporary refuge at Sen'jin Village.

sections.title: Zalazane's Grip
sections.body: Aggressive predators, tainted wildlife, and Zalazane's thralls now overrun the tropical islands. The rogue witch doctor uses malevolent hexes, voodoo fetishes, and ju-ju heaps to bend beasts and captive trolls to his will. Vol'jin's scouts and warriors set out often from their camp at Darkspear Strand. On these frequent sorties, they seek the remains of their fallen and a chance to strike down the mystic who stole their home.

faq.q: Why don't the Darkspear trolls live here right now?
faq.answer: Zalazane betrayed the Darkspear and used dark magic to strip his kin of their free will, turning them into obedient servitors. Chieftain Vol'jin ordered the tribe to evacuate to Durotar's mainland coast, where they founded Sen'jin Village as a base while they fight to reclaim their home.

Zalazane is a Darkspear witch doctor who turned against his tribe. His powerful voodoo and dark magic laid hexes over the islands, corrupted local wildlife, and enslaved fellow trolls as mindless thralls.

faq.q: What threats are on the islands?
faq.answer: Wild raptors, tigers, and corrupted beasts roam the islands. Zalazane's voodoo heaps and mind-controlled troll minions are there too, including hexed and voodoo trolls.

faq.q: How did the Darkspear tribe end up on these islands originally?
faq.answer: Thrall and the Horde rescued the Darkspear from a sinking island and hostile naga in the Great Sea. The trolls journeyed to Kalimdor, where they were granted the Echo Isles to settle beside their orc allies.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, the Echo Isles are their promised home in Kalimdor and a reminder of Zalazane's betrayal. Reclaiming them is a matter of tribal survival and personal honor.
For the Horde, securing the Echo Isles means stabilizing Durotar's southern coast, protecting Sen'jin Village, and holding its borders against naval threats and rogue mystics.
